body_html: Johnny aka “Bravo” has DJ numerous Wedding Parties, Private Parties, Graduation parties, and other special game day events. “If there’s two things I love in life it is Music and People. As a Professional DJ I get to take pleasure in both of those things.” Ever since a very young age Bravo has always been able to bring people together. He is excellent in connecting with all demographics and any type of audience. Expect to get a tasteful blend of modern day hits to old school classics. With a Degree in Music Production, Bravo is able to offer a unique experience while also catering to your every need.
